rationale: Test-only: five tests that built fixture paths from __FILE__ now take the checkout root from the PULP_SOURCE_DIR / PULP_REPO_ROOT definitions through test/support/fixture_root.hpp, and a lint rejects __FILE__ used as a path under test/. Under ccache base_dir plus Ninja, __FILE__ is relative to the build tree, so those paths resolved only from there. No design-import, Chromium, rendering or packaging code changes; only how tests locate checked-in fixtures.
